RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the August 3, 2006/Sravana 12, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Prime Minister;  Atomic Energy;  Coal;  Communications and
Information Technology;  External Affairs;  Housing and Urban Poverty
Alleviation;  Information and Broadcasting;  Overseas Indian Affairs;
Panchayati Raj;   Parliamentary Affairs;   Personnel, Public
Grievances and Pensions;  Planning;  Shipping, Road
Transport and Highways;  Space;  Statistics and
Programme  Implementation;   Urban
Development; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions —20
Halting of nuclear tests
†*161. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether differences between India
and USA regarding halting of nuclear tests
have been resolved;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the present status thereof?
Revival proposal of HDPEL
*162. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the revival proposal of
Hooghly Dock and Port Engineering Ltd.
(HDPEL);
(b) whether the same has been approved
by Board for Reconstruction of Public
Sector Enterprises (BRPSE);
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the action plan for improving the
order book position and cash flow
situation?
DDA land for schools and hospitals
†*163. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that DDA has
decided to sell plots for schools and
hospitals through auction;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the details of plots earmarked to be
sold under this scheme alongwith the
number of plots sold so far and the revenue
earned by DDA through it;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

51
(d) whether it is also a fact that such auction
of plots to schools and hospitals would
encourage them for arbitrary conduct; and
(e) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to avoid this situation?
Visit of foreign Secretary to
Sri Lanka
*164. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether India's Foreign Secretary
on an invitation from the Srilankan
counterpart, visited Sri Lanka (Colombo)
to settle issues with the LTTE;
(b) if so, the outcome of the visit; and
(c) what further steps if any are being
taken to ensure peace in the neighbouring
country?
Basic amenities at Metro Rail Stations
*165. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that despite huge
earnings by Delhi Metro Rail Corporation in
Delhi, no basic amenities like drinking water
and toilet facilities, etc. have been provided for
passengers at the Metro Rail Stations;
(b) if so, the reasons for not providing
such facilities for passengers at the Metro
Rail Stations; and
(c) whether Government intend to
provide such facilities and if so, by when
and if not, the reasons therefor?
Plight of slum dwellers in cities
*166. SHRI PRAVEEN RASHTRAPAL:
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND
URBAN POVERTY ALLEVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) the details regarding various projects
in hand to improve plight of slum dwellers
in the cities of Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata,
Hyderabad, Ahmedabad and Chennai;
(b) the norms for providing land/plots
to urban poor as on 31st March, 2006;
(c) whether his Ministry is aware of
various slum demolitions all over the
country by the respective State
Governments; and
(d) whether there is any move in his
Ministry to have an all India policy for slum
improvement and also deciding upon no
removal without alternative arrangements?
National Highways in Sikkim
*167. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the total length of National
Highways constructed in the country
particularly in the State of Sikkim during
the last three years, State-wise;
(b) whether Government have received
any proposal from the States including Sikkim
for construction of National Highways;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of amount sanctioned and
released for construction of NHs in the
country during this period, State-wise?

52
Re-launch of GSLV/INSAT-4C
*168. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the failure of the Geo
Synchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle
(GSLV) has since been analyzed/probed;
(b) if so, the results thereof;
(c) in what manner this failure would
impact on our  space research programme;
(d) whether Government have set any
schedule for the re-launch of  GSLV/
INSAT-4C; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Road accidents on
National Highways
*169. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that large number
of fatal accidents are taking place on roads
besides National Highways costing human

Total number of questions —155
Distribution of power to the
consumers
1019. SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANWARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the third unit
of the Tarapur Atomic Power Project which
would increase the country's nuclear power
generation by one-sixth, is expected to be
declared commercial six months ahead of
schedule;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the manner in which the nuclear
power proposed to be distributed to the
consumers?
Transmission system at Rajasthan
1020. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI VINAY KATIYAR:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have a
proposal to set up a transmission system
to supply electricity from the Rajasthan
Atomic Power Project;
(b) if so, the cost of the transmission
system;
(c) the target date set for its completion;
(d) the organization/corporation
entrusted with the task to install the
transmission system; and
(e) the details thereof?

236
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Restart of production at R.A.P.P.
†1021. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that production
has stopped in the first unit of Rajasthan
Atomic Power Project (R.A.P.P.),
Rawatbhata since October, 2004;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) by when the production would
restart; and
(d) if not, the steps being taken by
Government to compensate the loss
suffered by Rajasthan on account of
permanent closure of the first unit of
R.A.P.P.?
FDI proposals
1022. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether a large number of FDI
proposals are under consideration of
Government in the coal mines sector;
(b) if so, the details of the proposals,
State-wise;
(c) the status of those proposals; and
(d) the number of proposals presently
running with FDI?
Valuable waste lying unsold with CIL
1023. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Coal India
Ltd. has been holding for years dumps of
18 mt of waste, consisting coal rejects and
midlings, valued at some Rs. 1000 crores,
though it commands a premium in the
domestic market;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that while
the private sector miners sell such of their
waste material at about Rs. 600 per tonne,
CIL is unable to get any customer for want
of proper marketing strategy and the
required infrastructure; and
(d) the details of the steps being taken
to dispose of these huge stocks?
Proposal to delink CMPDIL from CIL
1024. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
delink Central Mine Planning and Design
Institute Ltd. (CMPDIL) from Coal India
Ltd. (CIL); and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Outsourcing in CIL to augment
production
1025. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether outsourcing is being
resorted to augment coal production in
different subsidiaries of Coal India Ltd.;
and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and
subsidiary-wise quantum of production
through outsourcing?

237
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Demand for increasing royalty on coal
†1026. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some coal
producing States have been demanding
increase in the rate of royalty on coal for
the last few years;
(b) the names of the States demanding
increase in the rates of royalty alongwith
the existing royalty-rates of the coal; and
(c) the rate and amount of royalty being
extended every year to the coal producing
countries?
Allotment of coal blocks to Jharkhand
†1027. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether any request has been
received from Government of Jharkhand
for allotment of coal blocks;
(b) whether Government of Jharkhand
have apprised the Central Government
about their priorities regarding coal blocks;
and
(c) if so, the decision taken by
Government in this regard?
Tribal land taken for coal mining
